text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training for the Kikuka Sho,
Narita Brian's conditioning was coming along nicely,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, the meeting was next, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Narita Brian began
looking up at the sky from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The frequency increased day by day, and with less than a month until the Kikuka Sho,
there was still no real progress even after making it through the summer...
choice_data_list: (...I can't let things stay like this.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Since you've come all the way to see me...
I take it this is about that training camp again?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Word is that Brian's condition
is finally back to top form.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if you resolve the regrets left behind that summer,
all that may remain is a brand-new regret.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And with the Kikuka Sho just around the corner.
Even so, do you truly wish for a mock race?
choice_data_list: That is precisely why she needs it right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...To think the day would come where I'm called upon to serve as a tune-up partner.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "No way!? The President is seriously running in a mock race!? And her opponent is—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it totally sounds like Brian-san!
Wait, didn't she go to the hospital recently, though?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Normally, no one would volunteer to face them
even in peak condition...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right after recovering, she jumps straight into facing the "Emperor."
Haaah, she really is something else in so many ways...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
This is...
choice_data_list: Because I thought I should run it at least once.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Don't leave yourself with any regrets, you hear?
Just don't leave yourself with any regrets, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I owe you one.
...And I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "I guess I should've relied on you from the start."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Because you're my Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Now, Rudolf.
I'll be taking the victory from you...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oho, 'a tiger's roar brings forth the wind'?
Then I shall say the same.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Let us do our utmost.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian bursts forward forcefully the moment the race starts.
However, Symboli Rudolf's start is just as clean and flawless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which one would emerge as the victor of this race?
The gathered crowd watched with bated breath.
The result of the race was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Narita Brian lost by a neck.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Considering how poor her condition was recently,
she put up quite a good fight, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Well, your opponent is Symboli Rudolf after all.
Even at your best, she's a difficult rival."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That was such a heated race, though~!
The President really is way too strong~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...The crowd's cleared out of the stands, huh.
choice_data_list: Well, the race is over now.
The race is over now, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I feel like I was shown the price of my own arrogance. Even if it was just a neck's margin, that difference was undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Am I really so far out of reach?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"That missed opportunity from that summer
has been stuck in my head, refusing to leave."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "If I could race, then no matter the opponent, no matter the situation—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Somewhere in my heart, I was overconfident that I would win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yet in truth, I lost. I was weak.
Unable even to manage my own body, misjudging my own capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You were aware of that.
Which is why you set up a race like this, isn't it?
choice_data_list: No, I always believed you could win.
No, I always believed you could win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... haha! Are you an idiot?!
You're just as big a fool as I am!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Can I run
just one more lap?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It throbs incessantly.
I thirst for it... and I cannot help it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Brian began
her run across the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stronger than spring, stronger than summer.
Her stride surely won't stop just yet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for your help the other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks.
Instead, drop by the student council room every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: When that time comes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then we can only hope
that time comes soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Also, I've had your strength
thoroughly beaten into me this time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't think this is all I'm capable of, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna climb even higher.
The next time I race you... I won't lose."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then, "when the time comes."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian declared war on the "Emperor."
—That rumor spread like wildfire throughout the academy.
